description: Source code for DES encryption driver for Linux kernel, implementing DES and 3DES algorithms with various modes (ECB, CBC, OFB, CFB, CTR). Includes function definitions, algorithm registration, and hardware interface logic.

methods.name: des_setkey
methods.description: Sets DES key for crypto transformation, expands key and stores in context.

methods.name: des_setkey_skcipher
methods.description: Sets DES key for skcipher (symmetric key cipher) context.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des
methods.description: Main interface to hardware DES encryption/decryption with mode and operation parameters.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ecb
methods.description: Configures hardware for ECB mode encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_cbc
methods.description: Configures hardware for CBC mode encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ofb
methods.description: Configures hardware for OFB mode encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_cfb
methods.description: Configures hardware for CFB mode encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ctr
methods.description: Configures hardware for CTR mode encryption/decryption.

methods.name: des3_ede_setkey
methods.description: Sets 3DES key, expands key, and stores in context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_des
methods.description: Initializes DES driver and registers algorithms.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_des
methods.description: Unregisters DES algorithms and cleans up.
